text: Current mouse helper comments say aWindow is optional and defaults to the current window. The implementation dereferences aWindow.windowUtils and calls aWindow.synthesizeMouseEvent without providing a default. Current draft callers pass an explicit window. Scoped documentation proposal: document the required target window or deliberately add and test a default, rather than relying on this comment. This is a source contract mismatch, not a reproduced failing caller. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: State the real target-window requirement in the mail mouse helper comments
